stem: C is the midpoint of AB, where A(7, -6) and B(-1, 0). Plot the point C.

hints.text: Check the order of the pair: the first number is read along the x-axis, the second along the y-axis.
Add the coordinates with their signs before halving.
The midpoint's x is the average of the two x-coordinates, and its y the average of the two y-coordinates.
